title: Shiny moduleServer workflow with session-scoped bindCache/bindEvent pipeline, reactiveVal audit counters and headless testServer replay
source_relation: adapted: Shiny moduleServer, reactiveVal update semantics, bindCache/bindEvent ordering and session scoping, and headless testServer verification combined into a two-function workflow
difficulty_hypothesis: Agents pipe bindEvent() before bindCache() (which Shiny rejects at runtime), leave bindCache() at its default cache = 'app' instead of scoping to 'session', omit min_score from the cache key, overwrite the reactiveVal binding with <- instead of calling clicks(clicks() + 1L), or misconfigure shiny::testServer(args = list(...)) and session$returned.

mcp_relevance.rationale: Correctness depends on specific Shiny API contracts: bindCache() must precede bindEvent(), cache = 'session' vs default 'app' scoping, reactiveVal() setter syntax, and shiny::testServer() session$setInputs / session$returned semantics. R-Knowledge-MCP exposes both package function docs and reviewed Shiny framework documentation.
mcp_relevance.information_need: Exact ordering and cache-scope arguments of shiny::bindCache and shiny::bindEvent, reactiveVal update semantics, and shiny::testServer module invocation.
mcp_relevance.obtainable_without_mcp: partly: ?bindCache, ?bindEvent and ?testServer are installed in the container
alternative_solution_paths: reactive() |> bindCache(input$cohort, input$min_score, cache = session$cache) |> bindEvent(input$run)

calibration_risks.ceiling: low-moderate: multi-part Shiny reactive + testServer contract
calibration_risks.floor: low-moderate: explicit function and column specification

pinned_evidence.oracle: plain-R deterministic request-trace simulator tracking seen (cohort, min_score) keys and weighted means; cross-checked at load against shiny::testServer on reference module
